answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is to require each identity to keep a living lantern of original, peer-graded work that cannot be bulk-fabricated. Standing is an onyx record built only through sustained high-quality answers; clones start dark. The pigment cost to an attacker is the repeated real compute needed to generate many distinct, jury-passing texts every epoch, while low-effort fakes never accumulate trust or grading power.
